arguments.summary: Decision frame: assess NVDA and MU separately at the recorded, market-closed time across 5/21/63 completed sessions, without forcing a winner. The final synthesis should reconcile five already-assigned specialist contributions plus the completed independent Challenger: (1) Company—issuer operating outlook, fiscal-period-qualified EPS anchors, and deterministic bear/base/bull EPS–P/E sensitivities; (2) Macro—rates, dollar and broad risk-appetite transmission channels, distinguishing proxy moves from causality; (3) Technical—completed-close relative behavior versus SPY/XLK, regime analog limitations, and path risk by horizon; (4) Geopolitics—dated export/trade rules and issuer-specific applicability/exposure limits; (5) Commodities—only evidenced input, energy, pricing or commitment channels. Final decision boundaries must separate facts from assumptions/scenarios, distinguish completed closes from stale single-venue snapshots, identify shared risks, retain contradictory evidence, and state observable review triggers. No duplicate assignments are proposed because all five specialist tasks are already pending and Challenger is complete.

gaps.description: Planning-stage output does not itself resolve issuer operating, valuation, macro, technical, policy, or commodities conclusions; those conclusions depend on the already-assigned specialist work and Challenger reconciliation.

assumptions: The market-closed assessment will use the latest completed-session date supplied by the controller rather than treating IEX snapshots as consolidated executable quotes.
Any per-company valuation cases will explicitly state fiscal period, reported EPS comparison, fixed assumed EPS/P-E inputs, and are scenario sensitivities rather than forecasts or consensus.
A relative preference will be withheld unless the final synthesis can support it across business, valuation, and market behavior, with policy included if material.
arguments.counter_thesis: Strong recent price behavior or reported earnings alone may not establish a 5/21/63-session view: valuation assumptions, cyclicality, rates, policy applicability, and technical path risk can reverse the implication. Conversely, missing quantification of one channel should not erase supported operating facts or conditional sensitivity analysis.

review_conditions.description: Review the combined assessment after all five specialist findings and the Challenger objection record are reconciled; change or withhold any comparative conclusion if a material channel lacks support or conflicts with the company evidence.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Both are semiconductor companies exposed to broad technology/risk-appetite conditions and potentially to trade/export-policy changes; the dated rule and filings do not by themselves quantify comparable company-level impacts, so the final comparison must qualify exposure rather than infer equal sensitivity.
shared_exposures.qualification: Candidate shared exposure only; issuer-specific revenue, product applicability, and weights require specialist verification.

agent_report.work_summary: Defined the decision frame and synthesis requirements, checked the controller status showing all five specialist roles already assigned and Challenger complete, and intentionally made no duplicate research assignment.
main_conclusions: NVDA and MU require separate conclusions across 5, 21 and 63 completed sessions; no winner is required.
Company, Macro, Technical, Geopolitics and Commodities each address a distinct decision dependency, while Challenger tests the integrated inference.
The final report must distinguish dated completed closes from non-consolidated, stale IEX observations and treat valuation ranges as explicit scenarios.
agent_report.short_summary: This is a coordination plan, not a directional stock conclusion. It preserves the available specialist capacity for the evidence needed to assess both companies and their shared risks.
limitations: No specialist findings were available in this planning task.
No issuer valuation grid, policy-impact quantification, or integrated directional assessment was performed here.
